recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中成片大型多角形組織球，胞質充滿嗜酸性、纖維狀的結晶物質而把核擠到一邊；抹片可見含結晶的組織球與胞質有包涵體的漿細胞，輕鏈免疫染色只有一側陽性，符合伴隨單株漿細胞腫瘤的結晶儲存組織球增生症（crystal-storing histiocytosis）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with interstitial sheets of large pale-to-bright eosinophilic cells between hematopoietic elements (panel A)
Large polygonal histiocytes with abundant densely eosinophilic, fibrillary to crystalline cytoplasm and small eccentric, compressed nuclei (panel B)
Aspirate histiocyte stuffed with purple needle- or rod-shaped crystalline material (panel C)
Plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and basophilic cytoplasm containing pink-red crystalline inclusions (panel D)
Paired immunostains with cytoplasmic staining in scattered plasma cells for one marker and absence of staining for the other (panels E, F), consistent with light-chain restriction
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular and contains interstitial aggregates and sheets of large histiocytes with abundant densely eosinophilic, fibrillary-crystalline cytoplasm that displaces small nuclei to the periphery. The aspirate shows histiocytes distended by needle-shaped crystalline material and plasma cells harboring intracytoplasmic crystalline inclusions. Paired immunostains show staining of plasma cells for one light chain/heavy chain marker and no staining for the counterpart, supporting a clonal plasma cell population. Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis associated with a plasma cell neoplasm (IgD kappa by clinical correlation).

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have pale 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than dense eosinophilic crystals and lack a light-chain-restricted plasma cell population.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial infection (e.g. MAI in pseudo-Gaucher histiocytes)
ddx.vs: Mycobacterial histiocytes have striated grey-blue cytoplasm with acid-fast bacilli, whereas crystal-storing histiocytes contain immunoglobulin crystals that stain with the clonal light chain.
These are CD68-negative non-hematopoietic tumors (desmin/myogenin or S100/SOX10 positive) and do not accompany a clonal plasma cell proliferation.

ddx.dx: Adult Fanconi syndrome-type light chain crystal deposition in plasma cells only
ddx.vs: Crystalline inclusions confined to plasma cells lack the sheets of crystal-laden histiocytes seen here.
